messages:
maria: FYI — invoices for acct `acme-corp` show ~3% more tokens billed after yesterday's routing policy tweak. Not sure if this is real usage or a dedupe bug.
ashok: I  flagged the `invoice_delta_by_route` metric — big spike from `edge-route-b` in the 21:40 UTC window.
sam: billing-bot also emitted a dup-event alert earlier. I'm pulling logs now.
billing-bot: ALERT: duplicate_event_ratio > 0.02 for service=metering_ingest (value=0.032) — see /alerts/4312
sam: quick scan: repeated POSTs to `/metering/v1/events` with the same `request_id` but different `x-route` header. Edge retry + route rewrite seems to have produced new dedupe keys so we double-count.
maria: can you paste a minimal example event?
sam: example event payload we saw: ```{"request_id":"r-9a8f","route":"edge-route-b","tokens":120,"received_at":"2026-03-18T21:40:12Z"}``` then ~3s later: ```{"request_id":"r-9a8f","route":"edge-route-c","tokens":120,"received_at":"2026-03-18T21:40:15Z"}``` Same request_id but route mutated by proxy.
leo: our dedupe key in metering-processor is currently `hash(request_id)` only, so if the event stream rewrites route header mid-flight we can get duplicates.
ashok: note — some customers purposely reroute for DR across regions; we probably don't want to globally dedupe across routes without policy.
maria: for immediate mitigation we should preserve original route origin at ingress and include it in the dedupe key. Also need a short-term backfill to collapse duplicates that hit invoices overnight.
olivia: UX note — Console rollouts/traffic page has no mapping for which routing-policy variant was active for a given invoice window. That would have made this easier to trace.
leo: quick patch proposal: set `dedupe_key = sha256(request_id || '|' || origin_route)` in the ingress emitter, and have metering-processor prefer inbound dedupe_key when present. This avoids changing dedupe semantics for customers that intentionally reroute.
sam: implementation plan: (1) patch ingress emitter, (2) add server-side check to ignore events with duplicate dedupe_key, (3) canary to 5% traffic for 10m. I'll prepare the k8s job/manifest.
ashok: dashboard work: add `metering.dedupe_hits` counter and a broken-out tile `invoice_delta_by_route` for last 24h + 7d compare. Also add an annotation layer showing routing policy rollouts.
billing-bot: NOTE: creating incident INC-2026-115 to track invoice adjustments & possible refunds. Link -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-115
maria: action items: sam (canary/deploy), leo (backfill + infra change), ashok (dashboards + policy), olivia (console feature request + rollout audit). I'll create the tracking ticket and link PRs.
leo: scheduling backfill in maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight. Will rate-limit writes and emit a dry-run report first.
ashok: +1 on adding an audit log for routing policy changes (who/what/when) in the console — this would have shortened RCA.
sam: starting canary now. Patch manifest: ```kubectl -n prod set env deployment/ingress-emitter DEDUPE_MODE=incoming_key && kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/metering-processor```
sam: early signal: duplicate_event_ratio -> 0.004 after canary :thumbsup:
maria: excellent. once canary stable, roll to 25% then full. Also draft a short customer comms batch for any invoices we adjust.
olivia: I'll open a console feature PR to expose per-invoice routing-policy mapping and link it to the billing timeline.
leo: after backfill completes I'll upload the reconciliation CSV to the billing S3 bucket and notify finance.
maria: thanks all. Please add short runbook steps to the incident ticket for rollback and refund flow.
ashok: one follow-up: let's add an integration test that simulates route rewrite + retry and asserts we don't double-count tokens.
sam: added test to `metering-processor/tests/` in my PR. Will request reviews.
maria: assigning owners in the ticket now. Good catch everyone.
